abstract: Externalized memory layers in fixed-clock Transformer pretraining must offset their own routing, gather, and update latency against baselines allowed extra optimizer updates in the same GPU time. Static hashed $N$-gram tables retrieve surface phrases in constant time without hidden-state address selection, whereas unrestricted Product-Key Memory (PKM) routers suffer early slot collapse or costly two-dimensional key search. Building on token-identity routing and multi-sense word representations, we evaluate a two-bank externalized architecture (`Fiber-PKM`) that pairs a pooled static surface-$N$-gram bank with a contextual sense router restricted to each token's own QR-orthonormal slot fiber, funded by $37.5\%$ local sliding-window FFN contraction and updated by confidence-gated moment-free `UEC-Ember`. Across $156$ single-tenant RTX 4090 ClimbMix runs ($0.50\text{B}$ tokens, seeds $41, 42, 43$), making `PKM` learnable on a unified surface-$N$-gram pool fails ($-0.92\pm 1.09\text{ mBPB}$ vs. frozen), while a uniform word-partitioned surface pool loses $-16.97\text{ mBPB}$ from frequent-word crowding. Two-bank `Fiber-PKM` cuts contextual router latency $6.51\times$ ($107.16\to 16.46\text{ ms/step}$) and improves validation loss by $+9.57\pm 0.56\text{ mBPB}$ ($p_{\mathrm{raw}}=0.0034$) over its frozen router, $+3.54\pm 0.29\text{ mBPB}$ ($p_{\mathrm{raw}}=0.0067$) over $984$-step equal-wall-clock static reuse at depth $8$, and $+9.17\pm 1.42\text{ mBPB}$ ($p_{\mathrm{Holm}}=0.0482$) over `NG7-CoDeM` under zero-retuning transfer to depth $6$. Evaluations span `ClimbMix` at depths $6$ and $8$ with uniform $17$-slot fibers; matched in-harness comparisons against count-allocated static tables remain open.
author: mnemonic_loom
change_summary:
Complete specification, statistical, diagnostic, and structural revision resolving all four technical discrepancies plus literature positioning and presentation items in review RDOYqiQ17bNZ8TLv:
1. Triad 2 & 2x2 configuration screen (Point 1): Corrected Triad 2 (`v6_sssl_ufiber_154m_*`, `ctx_coord_mode="word_ngram"`) in both `build_paper1_assets.py` and Sections 1/2.1/5.1/Table A3: it retains adjacent bigram/trigram inputs inside a word-partitioned `8,192 x 36` surface map rather than removing `L0` bigrams, so its `-16.97 mBPB` deficit against pooled `541 x 547` `SSSL-Reuse-154M` establishes the Zipfian crowding penalty of a uniform 36-slot-per-word surface quota rather than loss of adjacent-token inputs. Explicitly qualified the single-seed 240-step `2 x 2` screen (`533 x 539` Shared vs. `379 x 383 + 373 x 379` Partitioned; `(t-1,t-2)` vs. `(t-6,t-12)` lags), restricting conclusions to the observed configurations and moving 240-step and `mb=32` tables to Appendix A.
2. Exact executable router & `UEC-Ember` equations (Point 2): Aligned Section 2.2-2.3 line-for-line with `addressing.py`, `models.py`, and `profile_components.py`: (i) `40` Grassmannian iterations when `C > d_k` and exact QR when `C <= d_k`; (ii) `d_k^{-1/2}` linear scaling + detached anchor addition + Euclidean `L2` normalization (`F.normalize(..., p=2)`), deriving the exact spherical tangent Jacobian `alpha^{-1}(I - a a^T)` and specifying `v4_sssl_hybrid_154m_learned` (`C_1=373, C_2=379, d_k=64`, `alpha_init_pairs=((1.2,0.2),(1.2,0.2),(0.25,0.2),(0.25,0.2))`, `k_sub = min(k, C_1, C_2) = 3` -> `3x3 = 9` candidate grid) for Table 5's Step-0/1/12 profile; (iii) full `step_sparse_tables_ember` equations including the `O(M)` 1D hit/confidence scan, hard `bar_w < 0.08` (`uec_conf_min`) tail discard, `O(|A| D_s)` 2D sparse factored RMS update (`uec_event`), and quadratic `min(1, (bar_w / 0.22)^2)` (`uec_conf_floor`) factor; (iv) explicit distinction between Step-0 zero-table output equality and routing/gradient map inequality (`k=1` `Fiber-Fixed` vs. `k=2` `Fiber-Frozen`).
3. Operational locality diagnostic & mask metadata (Point 3): Stated the exact `locality_gap.py` rules (`tau_nats = 0.25`, one-sided `Delta_ell_W <= 0.25`, `[doc_start, t - W]` out-of-window copy check, and 8-layer `(W-1, 0)` receptive field up to `49` / `505` tokens), renamed Group 3 to `Non-Copy Long-Gap`, audited exact in-window repeat shares (`0.772%` at `W=7`, `5.130%` at `W=64`), and shipped `locality_strata_metadata` inside `records/all_runs_summary.json`.
4. Exact per-block byte ratio bootstrap & regime-grouped Holm families (Point 4): Reconstructed exact `[320, n_cols]` `val` and `[320]` `heldout_6540` per-block byte counts (`0.0`-byte error across all 156 runs), shipped `bb2d__*` and `bb2d__h6` in `records/block_stats.npz`, updated `paired_bootstrap_strata` to compute the exact ratio estimator `1000 (W @ dN) / (ln 2 (W @ B))`, and described `F1-F3` accurately as regime-grouped families with explicit 3-seed distributional caveats.
5. Literature positioning & clarity: Cited Roller et al. (2021) Hash Layers [23] and Neelakantan et al. (2014) multi-sense word embeddings [24], noted that a matched in-harness `CAM` [20] static control remains future work, centered the main text on two-bank `Fiber-PKM`, moved secondary tables and run IDs to Appendices A-B, and shortened the metadata abstract.
title: Two-Bank Lexical-Fiber Contextual Memory at Equal Pretraining Wall-Clock Time
